searchMetadata.descriptionEnglish: Current ticket status and independently verified departmental transfer history remain separate facts. Timeline contains only status, department and recorded event time.

sources.locator: Ticket Timeline GET uses verified enquiry id; service GetEnquiryTrackingsAsync queries tracking events by enquiryId; each event retains its department/status/time

Exact ticket detail and Timeline normal native reads under one authorized principal, followed by stable detail reread; no business values embedded

bindings.meaning: Complete projected ticket event metadata from the reviewed parent-owned timeline read. Keep event status, target department and recorded change time together. Department Processing with the returned department identifies that recorded transfer/processing stage, not successful completion of all processing. Reassigned is an assignment event, not a new current business status. Read current enquiryStatusObj separately from the verified EnquiryInfo detail; never treat the first timeline row as the current ticket status. No internal handling note, reason text, actor identity, communication or attachment is needed.

constraints: The server reviewed collection ownership contract is mandatory. A knowledge declaration, matching route, model-supplied metadata or old response cannot establish parent ownership.

Current ticket identity must be verified independently by its exact enquiryNumber and internal id. The gateway uses that actual id in the registered Timeline request and attests a complete field projection under the same principal and capture.

Current ticket status is the current EnquiryInfo enquiryStatusObj. Timeline events describe historical stages and assignments; preserve both sources and do not promote an old department stage into current completion.
Timestamps without offsets are displayed as source-local timestamps with timezone unspecified. Do not infer UTC or sort heterogeneous clocks as if their zones were established.
An empty verified timeline means no events returned by this authorized endpoint for the current ticket, not that no transfer ever occurred in every system.

Only the returned status labels, department and time are exposed. No target-department internal notes, message contents, attachments, actor contact details or sensitive records are part of this projection.
Event row counts are not ticket counts. A collection ownership proof does not authorize enterprise scope, change status, transfer a record or close a task.

The projected event labels are the exact returned statusName/nameEn. A localized answer may explain those statuses in the requested language but must not claim an unobserved localized dictionary label.
